name: Lychee Juice
description: Chilled fresh lychee blended with a little water and sugar into a fragrant, delicately sweet Asian fruit drink.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Combine the wonton wrappers and pork stock in a saucepan, blender, or pitcher, stirring well.
Add the white pepper and black vinegar, stirring gently so their flavor infuses the mixture.
Heat gently over low heat (or blend, or steep, depending on the drink) until well combined and fragrant, about 0 mins.
Strain through a fine sieve to remove any solids, if needed.
Sweeten to taste with soy sauce, adjusting gradually until the balance feels right.
Chill in the refrigerator, or pour straight over ice, depending on whether it is served cold or hot.
Garnish with chives just before serving.
tips: Serve in a chilled glass for the most refreshing result on a hot day.
Make a big batch and keep it chilled in the fridge — the flavor often deepens after a few hours.
